request.query: YouTube creators who review home espresso machines and coffee gear

queries: YouTube channels publishing hands-on reviews of home espresso machines for coffee enthusiasts
Creators comparing semi-automatic and automatic espresso machines for home kitchens
Video reviewers testing espresso grinders, portafilters, tampers, and other coffee accessories
Coffee equipment channels publishing buyer guides for choosing home espresso setups
interpreted.summary: YouTube creators whose published videos review home espresso machines and coffee gear for viewers evaluating coffee equipment.
criteria: ICP fit: active YouTube creators or channel owners at YouTube channel companies in coffee media or content creation
ICP fit: publishes videos about YouTube creators whose published videos review home espresso machines and coffee gear for viewers evaluating coffee equipment.
Buying/problem trigger: publishes reviews of home espresso machines
Buying/problem trigger: reviews coffee brewing gear or accessories
Buying/problem trigger: compares or evaluates equipment for home coffee use
Evidence quality: prefer evidence of hands-on testing and demonstrations, buyer guides or product comparisons, covers grinders, brewers, or espresso accessories
Evidence quality: posts, videos or profile mention home espresso machine, espresso machine review, coffee gear, coffee equipment, espresso grinder, coffee grinder, portafilter, espresso accessories
Disqualifier: exclude commercial cafe equipment reviewers focused only on restaurants, general lifestyle channels without coffee equipment reviews, coffee bean reviews without gear coverage
